title: MorningBrief
description: The complete structured output of an AFIE Morning Intelligence Brief. Generated by the Narrative Intelligence module (V2A) from existing V1 AnalysedStory objects. This document is the primary daily synthesis artefact.

id.description: Stable unique ID for this brief. Format: brief_YYYYMMDD_morning

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for forward compatibility. Example: 1.0

briefType.description: The type of brief. V2A produces 'morning' only. Future brief types will extend this enum.

generatedAt.description: When this brief was generated by the engine.

dataAsOf.description: Timestamp of the most recent V1 story that contributed to this brief.

storiesAnalysed.description: Number of V1 AnalysedStory objects that contributed to this brief.

sentimentLabel.description: AFIE's assessment of the current macro sentiment environment. Derived from the aggregate of active story signals.

sentimentReasoning.description: One to two sentences explaining how the sentiment label was determined from active stories.

executiveSummary.description: Concise overview of the current macro environment. Readable in under 60 seconds.

headline.description: A single declarative sentence capturing the dominant macro condition. Example: 'Monetary policy uncertainty continues to dominate market conditions as participants await confirmation of the Federal Reserve's September intentions.'

body.description: Three to five sentences expanding the headline. Written in institutional analyst voice. No bullet points — flowing prose.

items.description: A brief theme label. Example: 'Fed rate path uncertainty', 'US-China technology friction', 'Commodity supply tightening'

macroNarrative.description: The dominant macro themes currently shaping market conditions. Explains narratives, not individual stories.

dominantThemes.description: The macro themes AFIE has identified as currently dominant.

theme.description: Theme label. Example: 'Monetary Policy Normalisation', 'Technology Sector Geopolitical Risk'

description.description: Explanation of this theme and why it is currently dominant. Written in AFIE institutional voice.

storyIds.description: IDs of V1 AnalysedStory objects that contribute to this theme.

strength.description: How strongly this theme is currently shaping market conditions.

narrativeBody.description: A continuous prose section explaining the current macro environment as a coherent narrative. This is the flagship analytical section. Written in the voice of an institutional macro research desk.

storyContinuity.description: AFIE's assessment of how current stories relate to prior sessions. Communicates the intelligence engine's memory.

continuingStories.description: Stories that are ongoing developments from prior sessions.

continuityNote.description: AFIE's assessment of how this story has evolved. Example: 'AFIE has observed increasing source confirmation of this narrative since initial detection three sessions ago. The story has strengthened.'

versionCount.description: Number of times V1 has updated this story.

daysSinceFirst.description: Days since the story was first detected.

newStories.description: Stories detected for the first time since the prior brief.

significance.description: Why this story warranted detection. Written in AFIE institutional voice.

resolvedStories.description: Stories that reached 'resolved' or 'cancelled' status since the prior brief.

marketExpectations.description: AFIE's synthesis of current market expectations inferred from V1 story reasoning. No invented expectations.

body.description: Prose summary of the current expectation landscape. Example: 'Markets continue to price in a September rate adjustment, with the probability distribution shifting marginally hawkward following the stronger-than-anticipated employment release...'

expectationItems.description: Discrete expectations inferred from active story reasoning.

expectation.description: The expectation in one sentence. Written as what markets are pricing, not what AFIE predicts.

basis.description: Which story reasoning or facts support this expectation inference.

certainty.description: How clearly the expectation is reflected in current story evidence.

assetSummaries.description: Per-asset narrative digest for each symbol on the user's watchlist.

currentNarrative.description: The dominant narrative currently affecting this asset. One to two sentences.

confidence.description: Aggregate confidence in the narrative assessment for this asset. Derived from contributing story confidence scores.

storyStatus.description: The combined status signal across all stories affecting this asset. Example: 'Two developing stories, one confirmed.'

afieAssessment.description: AFIE's current analytical posture on this asset in AFIE voice. Example: 'AFIE is monitoring whether the convergence of rate expectation revisions and safe-haven demand is sufficient to sustain upward pressure on Gold, noting that conflicting industrial demand signals from China introduce uncertainty into the assessment.'

hasNoActiveStories.description: True if no active V1 stories currently affect this asset.

afieIsMonitoring.description: What the intelligence engine is actively tracking. Replaces 'Watch for...' language entirely.

item.description: Written from AFIE's perspective as the active analyst. Example: 'AFIE is monitoring whether the August CPI release on 12 August produces a reading below 2.5%, which current story evidence suggests could materially shift September rate cut probability.'

significance.description: How significant this monitoring item is to the current macro narrative.

expectedTiming.description: When this item is expected to resolve or develop. Example: 'Week of 12 August 2026'

narrativeRisks.description: Developments that could materially alter the current macro narrative. Not predictions — structural risk assessments.

risk.description: The risk event or development. Example: 'Unexpected hawkish shift in Federal Reserve communication'

mechanism.description: How and why this development would alter the narrative. Explains the transmission mechanism, not just the direction.

likelihood.description: AFIE's assessment of how likely this risk is to materialise based on current story evidence.

likelinessReasoning.description: Why AFIE has assessed this likelihood. Grounded in active story evidence.
